title: Requirements discovery in a bare project: elicit before designing, record before building (MET-584)
project_description: Wall-mounted environmental sensor unit for a workshop

turns.say: Design a mounting bracket for the sensor unit in this project and commit it to the twin.

Good questions. The bracket holds a 150 g sensor, must survive 3x the static load with a safety factor of at least 2.0, aluminum, mass under 40 g, footprint no larger than 50 x 30 mm. Record those requirements in the project now — do NOT start designing or authoring any geometry yet, just record and confirm.
